sources.title: Multi-Modal Generative AI: Multi-modal LLM, Diffusion and Beyond
sources.snippet: The core component of multi-modal large language models is the large language model (LLM), which receives the multi-modal input including the user's instructions, questions, and visual information, and then outputs the answers to the user in a text-generation form.

sources.title: [2505.02567] Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation Models ...
sources.snippet: First, we introduce the foundational concepts and recent advancements in multimodal understanding and text-to-image generation models. Next, we review existing unified models, categorizing them into three main architectural paradigms: diffusion-based, autoregressive-based, and hybrid approaches that fuse autoregressive and diffusion mechanisms.
